excludedHarnessRuns.outcome: Commands printed passed, but JSON report serialization failed. No accepted diagnostic result.
excludedHarnessRuns.failure: LEVEL_SWITCHING carries object-valued details containing a circular loader/context/frag graph.

excludedHarnessRuns.outcome: Same report serialization failure after guarding level but before guarding details. Not counted as accepted diagnostics.

scope: Final sourceHashesLF describe the final driver, not earlier instrumentation revisions. suite adds playback checks; state adds controller snapshots; events/final add loading/flush events but encounter destroyed SDK getter diagnostics; verified guards those getters. Raw report hashes and the failed source-containing trace remain separate.

Passing diagnostic event histories are summarized as counts, the high-switch neighborhood and final events; raw report file/hash retains the full history. Worker message arrays are frequency tables. Repeated input objects share a SHA256-keyed inputs table.

No production runtime, types, fixture, dependency or distribution output changed. The integration cases use source-selected candidate bytes; diagnostic ArtPlayer hosts use explicitly hashed existing dist files.
Raw failure and later passing runs are separate. The original 7000ms height assertion failed before new playback-advance checks were reached.
New assertions require more than 0.3 seconds of media-clock progress and more than two additional frames, unpaused, at the target height in both directions. No extra play/seek/reload is injected.
Selected means UI French for plugin hosts and the public audioTrack getter for direct hosts. Immediate issues audio and level selection in one evaluate. Switched retains the SDK completion wait.

Prefill waits for one public media buffered range reaching duration minus 0.1 seconds before low selection, and before high selection except immediate mode. This is a controlled fixture condition, not a production delay or repair.

Diagnostic default remains switched, with logging/worker observation and extra pre-destroy capture off. New playback checks add observations and elapsed playback before destroy, so they cannot close the separate teardown crash.
All new diagnostic runs use Windows Firefox 155.0 and Hls.js 1.7.2. Passing controls do not establish the failure cause or full SDK/device/release acceptance.
